description: Sourced check of a UK company from Companies House: status, type, incorporation date, registered office, SIC codes, filing health (accounts and confirmation statement overdue and by how many days, plus the GOV.UK late filing penalty band if accounts are overdue), insolvency and charges flags, active officers and PSCs, each with a source_url. VAT check: coming soon (a vat_number is accepted but not checked yet). Not a credit check, sanctions or PEP screening. Counts as 2 calls on an API key plan. Paid: $0.02 USD per call via x402, or use an API key (see /pricing).

company_number.description: Companies House number, e.g. 00445790 or SC123456 (find it with search_uk_company)

vat_number.description: Optional UK VAT number, e.g. GB123456789 (VAT check: coming soon, not checked yet)

name: check_uk_business
